product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Round Metal Side End Accent Table, 15"W, Black

A round tray top resting on slim, tapered legs brings a bit of mid-century influence to your room. 15.4"W x 15.4"D x 21.7"H; Leg Height: 20.7"H Metal top and legs with black finish Metal finished in black makes this ideal for a modern or industrial room Use for displaying small items, or as a place for your favorite beverage Assembly in 15 minutes; just screw on legs Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
